name: North Star & Guardrail Metrics
tagline: Defining primary value levers and counter-metrics to prevent unintended side effects.
description: Formulates paired North Star and Counter-Metrics (e.g. Conversion Rate vs. Return Rate, Data Ingestion Speed vs. Validation Accuracy) ensuring sustainable product growth.
evidence: Applied across Myntra Maya 5-agent copilot and Meesho returns teardown to model 34% return friction drivers.

name: Variance Modeling & Data Aggregation
tagline: Multi-tier data aggregation and mathematical reconciliation across complex entities.
description: Architected consolidation models aggregating 726+ data pointers mapped to 80+ KPIs across 8 regulated entities, managing board-level variance analysis.
evidence: Bajaj Finserv Group ESG Data Platform (201,215 tCO₂e consolidated across 8 financial entities).

name: RICE & 80/20 Materiality Scoring
description: Uses RICE (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort) paired with ESG materiality matrices to eliminate low-leverage feature creep and focus engineering sprints on primary pain points.
evidence: Sprih GHG Platform backlog grooming and 36-configuration RAGBench sprint under ₹0 budget constraint.

name: Weighted Decision Matrices
tagline: Structured trade-off evaluation under incomplete vendor data.
description: Constructed multi-criteria decision matrices weighting technical compliance, API flexibility, integration cost, and SLA reliability for high-stakes procurement.
evidence: Evaluated 6 enterprise vendors using weighted scoring for the Mega Forest Development Project.

name: Behavioral User Segmentation
tagline: Isolating distinct user personas, friction points, and willingness-to-pay.
description: Segments users by psychological intent and digital maturity rather than simple demographics. Conducts clustering on qualitative feedback to discover unmet needs.
evidence: Analyzed 1,055 Play Store reviews to isolate size inconsistency across Tier-2/3 Meesho cohorts.

name: Primary User Research & Surveys
tagline: Transforming respondent data into validated product insights.
description: Designs statistically sound quantitative surveys, runs user interviews, and applies NLP topic clustering to convert noisy responses into prioritized product specs.
evidence: Surveyed 43 LLM power users for Claude Prism and 30 e-commerce shoppers for Myntra Maya Copilot.

name: Hybrid RAG & Retrieval Systems
tagline: Combining dense semantic embeddings with sparse BM25 lexical search.
description: Architects production RAG systems with parent-document chunking, reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and vector database indexing to minimize hallucination in dense regulatory PDFs.
evidence: RAGBench (tested 36 pipeline configs against GHG Protocol tables) and PolicyLens (insurance clause citation linking).

name: Multi-Agent System Architecture
tagline: Orchestrating autonomous specialized LLM agents with deterministic guardrails.
description: Designs multi-agent architectures delegating domain tasks (e.g. Stylist, Sizing, Budget Optimizer, Returns Predictor) with structured state machines and evaluation layers.
evidence: Myntra Maya 5-agent conversational shopping system and Vera 2.0 message engine at Magicpin.

name: Prompt Optimization & Evaluation
tagline: System prompt engineering, few-shot conditioning & token confidence scoring.
description: Authors structured YAML system prompts, few-shot prompt libraries, and confidence breakdown layers classifying output tokens into Fact, Assumption, and Inference.
evidence: Claude Prism confidence scoring UI and Prompt Pilot optimization workbench.

name: Enterprise SaaS Product Ownership
tagline: Owning backlogs, writing PRDs, sprint planning, and managing vendor delivery.
description: Translates high-ambiguity enterprise mandates into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and API contracts. Bridges technical development teams and executive stakeholders.
evidence: Product Owner of Sprih enterprise GHG SaaS and internal PO for IBM Envizi deployment.

name: Process Standardization & Cycle Reduction
tagline: Slashing operational cycle time through UX-driven template design.
description: Re-engineers legacy, friction-heavy documentation workflows into standardized, repeatable digital tools that non-technical teams can operate effortlessly without training.
evidence: Standardised reporting templates at Re Sustainability, slashing documentation cycle times by 40% with 100% on-time compliance.

name: Regulatory Scoping & Compliance Tech
tagline: Translating dense legal/regulatory mandates into precise software specifications.
description: Decomposes evolving mandates (SEBI BRSR Core, RBI Climate Risk Draft, GHG Protocol, TCFD) into automated data collection schemas, validation rules, and audit-ready outputs.
evidence: EY Sustainability Advisory compliance roadmaps and ClimateLens RBI copilot.
